findings.title: Null dereference still possible in other methods using modelSupplier.get()
findings.body: The PR fixes getSubGroupsCount() by checking for null, but several other methods in the same class (e.g., getSubGroupsStream(String, Integer, Integer) at line 256, getSubGroupsStream(Integer, Integer) at line 262, getSubGroupsStream(String, Boolean, Integer, Integer) at line 268) still directly call modelSupplier.get().<method>() without a null check. If the group is concurrently deleted (the exact scenario this PR addresses), modelSupplier.get() can return null and cause a NullPointerException. The fix is incomplete and the same race can still crash the request.

findings.title: Reader thread is not joined and may outlive the test
findings.body: The test starts a new thread that loops until deletedAll is set to true, but never calls join() on that thread. As a result, the test method can return while the reader thread is still executing, leading to resource leaks, nondeterministic test cleanup, and potential interference with subsequent tests. Additionally, if the test fails before deletedAll is set, the thread will run forever and may hang the test suite. The thread should be joined with a timeout and/or made daemon.
